q_clock: Does the description say time moved on to some hour?
q_st_new: Does someone get a new bodily condition in the description (hurt, poisoned, tired, cold)?
q_st_gone: Does someone's bodily condition heal or go away in the description?
q_gain: Does the player gain something new in the description?
q_lose: Does the player lose, use up or give away something they carried?
q_move: Does the player go somewhere else this beat?
q_opt: As the player's next option, how natural and close to the scene is “{c}”?
q_clock_to: Which hour did time move on to?
q_lose_what: What did the player lose / use / give away?
q_soul_move: Does someone other than the player go somewhere else in the description?
